entities.name: Red mana
entities.description: One of the five colors of mana, drawn from mountains and embodying impulse, chaos, emotion and freedom.

entities.name: Black mana
entities.description: A color allied with red that values free will and the long term.

entities.name: Green mana
entities.description: A color allied with red that embraces instinct and emotion.

entities.name: Blue mana
entities.description: An enemy color of red that values logic and careful thought.

entities.name: White mana
entities.description: An enemy color of red that values law, order and the group.

relations.note: Red sees white as a totalitarian menace.
relations.quote: In white, red sees a totalitarian menace that is bent on absolute control of everything

relations.note: Red sees blue as having buried emotions in favor of rational thought.
relations.quote: In blue, red sees a color that has completely buried emotions in favor of careful, rational thought

relations.note: Red sees black as living its own life under its terms.
relations.quote: In black, red sees a color willing to live its own life under its terms

relations.note: Green also embraces emotions on a fundamental level.
relations.quote: To red, green is another color that embraces its emotions on a fundamental level
